kilde: Paro (2406 moh), NCHM Bhutan 1996–2017, via Wikipedia

en.kilde: Paro (2,406 m), NCHM Bhutan 1996–2017, via Wikipedia

maneder.no: Kaldt (nattefrost), men klart. Høye pass kan ha snø. Lite turister.
maneder.en: Cold (night frost) but clear. High passes may have snow. Few tourists.
Cool and clear. Punakha festivals (see events).

maneder.no: Rhododendron starter, god sikt. Paro Tsechu (se Vinduer).
maneder.en: Rhododendrons begin, good visibility. Paro Tsechu (see events).
Spring peak season: rhododendrons in bloom, mild.

maneder.no: Varmere, mer skyer/dis mot slutten av måneden.
maneder.en: Warmer, more cloud/haze towards the end of the month.
Monsoon begins; clouds hide the mountains.

maneder.no: Monsun: regn, jordras på veiene, dårlig fjellutsikt.
maneder.en: Monsoon: rain, landslides on the roads, poor mountain views.

maneder.no: Beste måned: klart, tørt, festivaler. Toppsesong – book tidlig.
maneder.en: Best month: clear, dry, festivals. Peak season – book early.

maneder.no: Klart og tørt, kjøligere. Svarthalset trane i Phobjikha (se Vinduer).
maneder.en: Clear and dry, cooler. Black-necked cranes in Phobjikha (see events).

maneder.no: Kaldt, men klart og stille. Lav trengsel.
maneder.en: Cold, but clear and calm. Few crowds.

vinduer.no: Svarthalset trane-festival i Gangtey 11.11 hvert år
vinduer.en: Black-necked Crane Festival in Gangtey, 11 Nov every year
